authorization_conditions: Use the frozen 365.25-day, 20-microsecond C3 waveform without changing its phase.
Preserve the release PLRedNoise component and exclude WaveX from all C0/C3 joint fits.
Compare same-run C3-minus-C0 circular coefficients separately for low-rank and explicit full-covariance solvers.
Report ordinary timing-model absorption, annual-signal recovery, astrometric covariance, astrometric displacement, and solver stability as separate diagnostics.
Do not interpret robust matched-null transfer as independent identification of an annual real signal when astrometric coupling is strong.
Require valid execution, warning hygiene, provenance, and resource hard gates; treat periodogram outcomes as uncalibrated diagnostics only.
Stop after publishing the C3 and Pilot 0 review records; no real-data search or later injection case is authorized.
